notes:
Venture 0.29 — Terrain in the right place, and planning with no signal

• Terrain following now uses correctly placed ground. Terrain from USGS was being placed slightly north or south of where it really is, more so the farther from the middle of the survey, which on hills changed the height flown above the ground. It is now placed exactly. After updating, the controller downloads each saved plan's terrain again the first time it has internet.

• Before your first terrain-following flight on this version: on each aircraft, open Configuration → Drone → SD CARD and format it, then power the aircraft off and on. This clears terrain the aircraft saved under the earlier version. Formatting erases the aircraft's flight logs on that card, so copy any you need first.

• Plans made with no signal now upload. They use SRTM terrain until the controller has internet, then switch to USGS 3DEP by themselves. The Terrain Following step says which one a plan is using.

• A terrain SD card in the controller lets plans made with no signal use USGS 3DEP anywhere in the lower 48.

• Every plan shows its estimated flight time and number of flights, and Auto picks the sweep angle that flies fastest.

• The ARMED pill shows how long the aircraft has been armed.

• Wi-Fi: saved networks that are out of range can be removed from the list, and WI-FI OFF turns the radio off.

• The controller keeps a log under Venture/Logs that can be copied off over USB when reporting a problem.

Installing over the top keeps your missions and settings.
